raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: gtk
  version: "4.22.5"
  version_majmin: ${{ (version | split('.'))[:2] | join('.') }}

package:
  name: gtk4  # note customization
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://download.gnome.org/sources/${{ name }}/${{ version_majmin }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: 7fd725deb2cb3f8dc218ad862c5056ff8548f49d3b0e4081796e444c22d19686
  patches:
    - patches/001-win32-fix-black-borders.patch

build:
  number: 0
  dynamic_linking:
    missing_dso_allowlist:
      - if: osx
        then: /usr/lib/libcups.2.dylib

requirements:
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('gtk4', upper_bound='x') }}
    # gtk apps need at least a default icon set for fallback
    - adwaita-icon-theme
  ignore_run_exports:
    # We need to pull in metapackages for these below to get devel files, but
    # don't depend on these libraries directly:
    by_name:
      - libexpat
      - liblzma
    from_package:
      - libxml2-devel
  build:
    - meson
    - ninja
    - gobject-introspection
    - packaging  # workaround: this is needed for glib's gdbus-codegen
    - pkg-config
    - shaderc
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - if: linux
      then: libegl-devel
  host:
    - cairo
    - expat
    - epoxy
    - freetype
    - gdk-pixbuf
    - if: osx
      then: gettext
    - glib
    - harfbuzz
    - libtiff
    - libpng
    - libjpeg-turbo
    - liblzma-devel
    - zlib
    - libgraphene
    - if: win
      then: libiconv
    - librsvg
    - libxml2-devel
    - pango
    - libvulkan-loader
    - libvulkan-headers
    - if: linux
      then:
        - libcups
        - libdrm
        - libxkbcommon
        - wayland
        - wayland-protocols
        - xorg-libice
        - xorg-libsm
        - xorg-libx11
        - xorg-libxcomposite
        - xorg-libxcursor
        - xorg-libxdamage
        - xorg-libxext
        - xorg-libxi
        - xorg-libxinerama
        - xorg-libxfixes
        - xorg-libxrandr
        - xorg-libxrender
        - xorg-libxtst
        - xorg-xorgproto
  run:
    - hicolor-icon-theme
    - pango
    - libgraphene
    - fribidi
    - fontconfig
    - if: linux
      then: ${{ pin_compatible('libcups') }}
    # The post-link script uses gio-querymodules from glib-tools
    - glib-tools

tests:
  - script:
      # check that the binaries can run
      - gtk4-encode-symbolic-svg --help
      - gtk4-update-icon-cache --help
      - if: unix
        then: gtk4-launch --help
    requirements:
      run:
        - pygobject
  - package_contents:
      # other binaries require a display, check that they get installed
      bin:
        - gtk4-builder-tool
        - gtk4-query-settings
      # verify that (some) headers get installed
      include:
        - gtk-4.0/gdk/gdk.h
        - gtk-4.0/gsk/gsk.h
        - gtk-4.0/gtk/gtk.h
      # verify that pkgconfig files and gi typelibs get installed
      files:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - lib/pkgconfig/gtk4.pc
            - lib/pkgconfig/gtk4-unix-print.pc
            - lib/girepository-1.0/Gdk-4.0.typelib
            - lib/girepository-1.0/Gsk-4.0.typelib
            - lib/girepository-1.0/Gtk-4.0.typelib
        - if: linux
          then: lib/pkgconfig/gtk4-x11.pc
        - if: osx
          then: lib/pkgconfig/gtk4-macos.pc
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/lib/pkgconfig/gtk4.pc
            - Library/lib/pkgconfig/gtk4-win32.pc
            - Library/lib/girepository-1.0/Gdk-4.0.typelib
            - Library/lib/girepository-1.0/Gsk-4.0.typelib
            - Library/lib/girepository-1.0/Gtk-4.0.typelib

about:
  homepage: http://www.gtk.org/
  license: LGPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: Version 4 of the Gtk+ graphical toolkit
  description: |
    GTK is a multi-platform toolkit for creating graphical user interfaces.
    Offering a complete set of widgets, GTK is suitable for projects ranging
    from small one-off projects to complete application suites.
  documentation: https://developer.gnome.org/gtk4/
  repository: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gtk

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - danyeaw
    - ryanvolz
    - pkgw
    - tschoonj
